steps.title: 声明完成 · 交给采纳门
steps.detail: 模型说大殿已完成，由采纳门决定能否交付。
steps.evidence: The East Main Hall of Foguang Temple has been designed and built from the brief and photograph. It is a 7x4 bay timber hall, 34m across the front and 17.7m deep, with two rings of columns, large bracket sets on every column head (56% of column height), deep eaves, a gentle hipped roof, and no posts or beams protruding through the roof. All structural checks passed: bearing (0 floating), weights (all columns within 10 MPa), settle (0 fell), shake (0 fell). The brief check and shot-judge both passed.
